name: SA6 MK2
driverConfig: 6BA (Sonion dual woofer + 2× Knowles custom mid + Knowles dual tweeter)

materials.shell: German Nice-Fit hand-poured UV acrylic resin
materials.cable: Hulk Pro Mini (Furukawa monocrystalline copper, Q-Lock Plus modular)

accessories: Hulk Pro Mini cable with Q-Lock Plus (3.5mm + 4.4mm plugs)
Multiple tip types including S&S and XL
pros: Excellent pure BA implementation with strong resolution and layering
Two switchable tuning modes (Default + Atmospheric Immersion)
Premium modular cable with Q-Lock Plus
cons: Bass quantity remains moderate even with the immersion switch
Shell shape may not suit every ear
insight: SA6 MK2 is frequently cited as one of the best pure balanced-armature implementations in its price range. It balances technical performance with musicality and remains a favorite among listeners who prefer the speed and precision of BA drivers. The dual tuning switches and excellent accessory package further increase its appeal.
